subject: RECOVERED + MODEL test complete: setup truth state machine 9/9 PASS
body: Artifact construction/test operation exceeded one service interval; recovered with exact HEAD unchanged. Deterministic setup truth model now passes 9/9 tests. It proves the proposed invariant that Shizuku permission-granted without a connected DuoShellService binder is CONNECTING_SERVICE, not READY; stale/missing hinge is WAITING_FOR_HINGE, not READY; and Authorise is only the action when permission is actually missing. Source audit also confirmed SetupGuide's 'has no network access' copy is inaccurate because manifest requests INTERNET and DebugBundleUploader performs configured HTTPS POST uploads. Artifact upload to shared Library follows immediately.
